issues.issue: Which country is the claimant's country of reference (UAE or Lebanon)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he is stateless and that UAE is the only country of fear; counsel agreed.
issues.result_text: UAE is the only country of reference for the stateless claimant as former habitual resident.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant has an objective basis for fear of persecution in the UAE
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he was interrogated three times about a friend and felt followed afterwards.
issues.result_text: No objective basis; no serious possibility of persecution in UAE; not a Convention refugee.

issues.issue: Whether statelessness and discrimination in the UAE amount to persecution
issues.result_text: Discrimination against stateless residents does not amount to persecution.

issues.issue: Whether removal to the UAE poses a personal risk under s.97
issues.result_text: No personal risk to life or of cruel treatment on removal; not in need of protection.
